text:
ravi: quick note 999ran a focused onboarding for citrine-slim-v3 across our recall_short + recall_longtail holdouts. attaching CI blurb.

embed-ci-bot: CI run 4467801234 summary: citrine-slim-v3
- baseline (f32): R@1=0.672 R@5=0.857 R@10=0.901 silhouette=0.46
- int8 (PTQ): R@1=0.664 R@5=0.850 R@10=0.896 silhouette=0.45
- int4 (per-tensor PTQ): R@1=0.621 R@5=0.813 R@10=0.865 silhouette=0.38
- short-query R@1 (f32)=0.598 (int4)=0.542
Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runs/4467801234 (per-query.csv + umap)

jules: int4 per-tensor is brutal on short queries. could be calibration sampling.

manon: typo: i'm mona :) but yes, stratified calib might help. we saw similar on another model.

tarik: paste eval command? want to reproduce.

ravi: eval command used:
```bash
./bench/eval_holdouts.sh \
  --model citrine-slim-v3 \
  --quant posttrain_int4 \
  --holdouts recall_short,recall_longtail \
  --calib_samples 4096 --index hnsw --k 10 --seed 99
```

jules: plan: 1) re-run int4 with stratified calibration (oversample tail tokens) 2) try per-channel int4 calibration 3) run small int8-QAT on stratified samples.

manon: i'll queue stratified per-channel int4 now (low cost). also create 300-sample human pack from short-query cohort for A/B.

tarik: can we also test end-to-end rerank fallback? i.e., int4 for candidate gen + CPU cross-encoder rerank for short queries.

ravi: yes, add rerank path to experiment matrix. if int4 recall recovers within 0.02 abs, we'll gate rollout with rerank fallback; else prefer int8-QAT.

embed-ci-bot: job queued: run_id=4467801301 (per-channel stratified int4). ETA ~20m. logs: https://redwood.internal/runs/4467801301/logs

manon: i'll run microbench for latency: rough p95 on devbox: per-tensor int4=6.9ms, per-channel int4=7.6ms, int8=8.9ms. will verify on infra.

jules: great. once per-channel stratified run finishes pls post per-query diffs and a small umap image. we'll decide gating.
	ravi: thanks team 999we'll hold off rollout until human A/B + stratified probe complete.
